payload.title: Close target-preserving feature-view augmentation
payload.decision: Reject H020/T027 without a formal experiment; preserve E011 as deployment primary and queue only a separately preregistered original-view domain-robust objective screen.
payload.rationale: All target-preserving augmented-view candidates worsen E011. The strongest eligible branch loses 0.0411048068 RMSE and fails broad spatial/typewell/horizon transfer. The unaugmented original-view comparator gains 0.0919232588 and improves global slices, but misses the 0.15 gain, 17/25 cell, T025, and every-domain gates and regresses spatial group 0 plus three typewell groups.
payload.revisit_trigger: Do not add or retune causal views, masks, indicators, source weighting, or larger models. Revisit only with a materially new causal input. A fresh objective-only screen may use one original view per well, training-only group information, exact outer isolation, and no inference routing.
